_readme: Accepted phantom-column findings for `npm run check:select-columns` (SELECTCOLS.1).
An entry means: the checker cannot see that this column is real, we have VERIFIED it against the live schema, and here is when we will re-check.
Empty is the healthy state. Correct the column name, or add the column in a forward-only migration, before reaching for this file.
file     repo-relative path exactly as the checker prints it, e.g. "src/lib/sequences/enrol.js"
column   the column the checker could not find
reason   HOW you know it exists. Name the migration or say you read information_schema.columns on the live project. 'looks fine' is not a reason.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. Past this date the gate FAILS until someone re-decides. Keep it short — a quarter at most.
Entries cannot rot: an expired entry fails exactly like an unlisted column.
